description: This file defines a utility enum SystemPresenceInfo with static methods to retrieve system-related information, such as the time since the last input event and the primary IPv4 address.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the seconds since the last user input event, or nil if invalid.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Returns the primary IPv4 address as a string, or nil if unavailable.
